enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night with the fan on low for air circulation during the heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull sheet over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull sheet up. Push sheet down. Turn to back. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to left side again. Adjust fan speed. Continue sleeping. Wake up briefly. Turn over. Sleep again.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs over side. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Open bathroom door. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Cup hands under water. Splash water on face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast and drinking water before the hot day ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on kitchen light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk carton. Close refrigerator. Open cabinet. Take out bowl. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Pick up spoon. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink water from glass. Stand up. Rinse bowl. Place bowl in sink. Wipe mouth with napkin. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag for the hospital shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Place ID badge in bag. Place water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Check mirror. Adjust collar. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Put on shoes. Pick up bag. Open door. Walk out. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, caring for patients during the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Change into scrubs. Attend morning meeting. Check patient charts. Administer medication. Take vital signs. Assist with procedures. Talk to patients. Say 'How are you feeling?' Talk to colleagues. Update records. Take lunch break. Eat lunch. Return to work. Continue patient care. Handover to next shift. Change out of scrubs.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Sit down. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Put down bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a cool shower and changing out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Remove work clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse off. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry with towel. Put on clean clothes. Hang wet towel. Turn off bathroom light.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating a light dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV, keeping the light off and using fans instead of the air-conditioner during the evening peak tax hours
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Stand up. Get water. Sit back. Continue watching. Turn off TV. Turn off fan. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading the washing machine and running a load of laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Gather dirty clothes. Load clothes into machine. Add detergent. Close door. Turn on washing machine. Select cycle. Press start. Wait. Check machine. Adjust settings. Turn off machine. Open door. Remove clothes. Transfer to dryer. Turn on dryer. Set timer.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the personal computer at the desk to review clinical notes and complete continuing education modules
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Enter password. Open clinical notes software. Review notes. Open web browser. Navigate to continuing education module. Read module. Answer questions. Submit answers. Close browser. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the kitchen, washing up and preparing food and water for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Put away clean dishes. Wipe counter. Wash remaining dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes. Take out food container. Prepare lunch. Fill water bottle. Place in refrigerator. Wipe table. Turn off kitchen light.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a second cool rinse and completing night skincare routine
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on shower. Adjust water. Step in. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry. Apply cleanser. Rinse face. Apply toner. Apply moisturizer. Brush teeth. Turn off light. Leave bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the fan running to stay cool
enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Adjust pillow. Turn to side. Continue reading. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Turn off lamp. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Close eyes.

Lie down on bed. Pull sheet over body. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull sheet up. Push sheet down. Turn to back. Bend knees. Stretch arms. Turn to left side again. Continue sleeping.
